summary: Endpoint went down for 4 hours during maintenance; lost 1,200 order events with no Cloud Storage archive or Cloud Run API to replay them.
Weekend outage meant our team only noticed failed webhooks on Monday morning (48+ hours later), but BigQuery partitions and Firestore docs were already purged.
Security compliance requires rotating HMAC signing keys every 30 days without dropping in-flight webhooks; need active primary_key and previous_key in Firestore.
Transient 502 Bad Gateway from our load balancer caused missed shipment updates; automatic exponential backoff would have solved it.
After fixing a bug in our webhook consumer, we had no way to re-trigger failed events from the past 12 hours.
2-hour retry window is too short when a downstream region has a 4-hour incident; need 24-hour retry schedule + 7-day Firestore and BigQuery retention.
Cannot adopt webhook signing until zero-downtime key rotation with two active keys in Firestore tenant config is supported.
Need bulk replay API (`POST /v1/webhooks/replay`) on Cloud Run reading archived payloads from a Cloud Storage dead-letter bucket after ERP upgrades.
When our endpoint recovered, burst retries from Cloud Run overwhelmed our small worker pool; need configurable max concurrency per tenant.
Hard to debug 400/500 responses from our receiver without querying HTTP status and attempt timestamps from the BigQuery-backed delivery log endpoint.
